coverage_basis: Every admitted original paragraph and table row, not a sample of known weak spots.

sections.title: Sixth-house/XLIV opening, timing hierarchy and initial observations
sections.reason: Candidate S01 combines independent source-map S00 and S01: heading/title, three time bases and all four observations. This is a segmentation choice, not an omission.

sections.title: What part of the Body is afflicted
sections.reason: The opening first-house clause and its continuation, illustration, corroboration and sixth-house extension are covered.

sections.title: From what cause the Sicknesse is
sections.reason: All elemental-cause paragraphs, including the PDF278–279 continuation, are covered.

sections.title: Diseases signified by the Houses
sections.reason: All twelve house rows are represented once and their complete item lists were checked.

sections.title: Diseases signified by the Signes
sections.reason: All twelve sign rows are represented once. Cancer crosses PDF279–280; the anomalous printed244 label is retained.

sections.title: Diseases of the Planets
sections.reason: All seven planet rows are present, including the PDF280–281 division and opposite sex-specific Sun/Moon eye assignments.

sections.title: Transition from location/cause to duration and its stated purpose
sections.reason: The candidate separates the unheaded synthesis/purpose transition that was included in independent source-map S06.

sections.title: Whether the Disease will be long or short: seasons and planetary duration
sections.reason: The complete season and planetary-duration discussion is covered, including the PDF281–282 transition.

sections.title: Signes of a long or short Sicknesse
sections.reason: The full long/short section through the upper PDF287 translation-of-light passage is covered, including all cross-page qualifications and the initial Pisces carryover.

sections.title: Testimonies that the Querent shall live and not dye of the infirmity now afflicting
sections.reason: All survival testimonies from lower PDF287 through upper PDF289 are covered, with reception, dignity, affliction and crisis qualifications.

sections.title: Arguments of Death
sections.reason: All material from Arguments of Death through the final shew death sentence is covered. Nondeath duration/danger statements keep their actual outcomes. Dariot remains outside scope.

source_first_map_difference: CandidateS01 combines independentS00+S01; candidateS07 separately represents the transition within independentS06. Later headings are offset. Both maps cover the same content; equal unit counts do not imply identical segmentation.
